caption: The drawing depicts a brass or bronze oval drawer pull with two views: a front view on the left and a side view on the right. The front view shows an oval backplate with intricate detailing, including a central medallion with a raised circular boss, flanked by symmetrical leaf motifs and additional small decorative elements. Attached to the backplate is a rounded, hinged handle, which is depicted in a gold or yellowish-bronze color, matching the backplate. The side view to the right illustrates the profile of the oval backplate and the handle hanging downwards. The drawing is rendered primarily in shades of yellow, gold, and greenish-brown, giving a metallic appearance. The objects are centered on an off-white or beige background, with a scale in inches placed below the left object for reference, and the words "JMET RIZA" written in small text near the bottom right. The overall layout is clean, with the objects presented within a faint rectangular border marked along the edges of the page.
title: Drawer Pull
